summary: When a DNS query is redirected by a CNAME or DNAME, the answer can involve several lookup rounds. This RFC clarifies how the response code (RCODE) and status bits in the final answer relate to the first lookup and to the later ones. It updates RFC 1035, RFC 2308 and RFC 2672.

eli5.summary: If you ask for a person and get pointed to a new address, the final note should say how the whole trip went. This RFC says which part of the trip the answer's status describes.

questions: how does rcode work with cname redirection
